```{r}
my_data <- read.delim("/nesi/nobackup/uc04105/PDB_alpha/relative_freq_aa_atm_fl.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

#add category to the set
my_data <- my_data %>% 
  mutate(
    type_seq = case_when(
      grepl('fl_tm', Name) ~ 'full_length',
      grepl('tm', Name) ~ 'transmembrane',
      grepl('fl', Name) ~ 'full_length'))
```



```{r}
library(devtools)
#install.packages("factoextra")
library(factoextra)
res.pc <- prcomp(my_data[-c(35,41),-c(1,2,23)], center = TRUE, scale.=TRUE)

fviz_pca_ind(res.pc,
             col.ind = "cos2", # Color by the quality of representation
             gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
```

```{r}
fviz_pca_var(res.pc,
             col.var = "contrib", # Color by contributions to the PC
             gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
```

```{r}
(length(group_variable))
group_variable <-as.factor(my_data$type_seq[-c(35,41)])
fviz_pca_ind(res.pc,
             geom = "point",
             habillage = group_variable, # Use the grouping vector here
             addEllipses = TRUE,
             palette = "Paired", # Use a color palette
             legend.title = "Species",
             repel = TRUE # Avoid text overlaps
             )
```
